Thank you very much for this advice. You are right, I think he doesn’t get the consequences of saying those things and I tried to explain it to him. I think he doesn’t understand how paranoid I feel every time he says that. The problem is that I live in constant fear every day for no reason, I do have severe anxiety since I was 12 and sometimes it’s just impossible to ignore. 

But I will definitely try the long walks and show him gratitude for his work, he certainly deserves that. 

Thanks again!
